details.content:
## Guidelines / Demarcation

**DL, RL**: clear. basically theory.

**Agentic systems**: AI agents concepts + Patterns

**LLM engg**: fine-tuning, reason, pre/post-training

**Dev tooling:** tools that can be easily incorporated to improve existing workflows, infra, dev practices. For example new databases. duckdb, pandas -> polars. mlflow. prefect. or platforms like docker, runpod. designed for one-off things & mostly things useful for development, improve dev QoL.

**App development:** Frontend / fullstack apps, large-scale data applications, system design. Maybe include 3-4 notebooks series covering a project. So these are more project based instead of documentation based like the above. Also include devops / mlops frameworks if its more "production" oriented than dev / tooling. Maybe include some Terraform, data engg. See datatalks.club zoom camps. 

## Resources

- DL: UFAL course -> sgrivnod pytorch tutorials
- RL: lapan book 3e. maybe alberta coursera (?)
- LLME: raschka books LLM + reasoning models
- Agentic: Ghassemi course + YT vids
- App development: YT vids + udemy. 

NOTE: always try to incorporate / re-use old stuff / old notebooks.
